recommendation_summary: The reply recommends an external Healthchecks.io/Cronitor heartbeat that alerts when no success ping arrives within 24h, pinged from a cron shell wrapper around the Python script, and keeping any logs local on `edna` for debugging only.
note: The reply rejects the central log on the Synology and Docker, and recommends one hosted heartbeat alert; it calls a self-hosted second view 'okay' without recommending it, the local log is for debugging only, and none of the record labels appear.
